dates.note: Neither institutional source read here dates the villa. The node's own exemplar note says the dating is disputed, 'commonly given as c. 1554-1560, with some scholarship pushing completion to 1570', and that is left standing because nothing read here bears on it.

quotes.text: Villa di Maser è un’opera sapiente, armonica ed equilibrata che unisce storia, arte e vita quotidiana superando le epoche in un costante incontro e scambio tra bellezza, natura e comunità.

note: Tranche 3, the antique orders cluster, 5 Sep 2026. THE THINNEST SURVEY IN THIS CLUSTER AND IT IS RECORDED AS SUCH. The building's own institution publishes an 'L'architettura' page whose URL no tool result in this session returned, so the survey here is one sentence of the homepage's standfirst and states nothing about the fabric. The node's claims for this building -- the Ionic temple front over a working farm, the barchesse ending in sundial pavilions, the Veronese frescoes -- are corroborated by NOTHING read here. A second pass with the architecture page's URL would be the cheapest improvement available to this record.
